doc.brief: The QApplication class manages the GUI application's control flow and main settings.
doc.index_brief: Manages the GUI application's control flow and main settings

QApplication(int &argc, char **argv).brief: Initializes the window system and constructs an application object with *argc* command line arguments in *argv*.

QFont font(const QWidget *widget).brief: Returns the default font for the *widget*.

QFont font(const char *className).brief: Returns the font for widgets of the given *className*.

QPalette palette(const QWidget *widget).brief: If a *widget* is passed, the default palette for the widget's class is returned.

QPalette palette(const char *className).brief: Returns the palette for widgets of the given *className*.

QString styleSheet() const.brief: This property holds the application style sheet

QStyle * setStyle(const QString &style).brief: Requests a [QStyle](xref:qt:QStyle) object for *style* from the [QStyleFactory](xref:qt:QStyleFactory).

QWidget * activeWindow().brief: Returns the application top-level window that has the keyboard input focus, or `nullptr` if no application window has the focus.

QWidget * focusWidget().brief: Returns the application widget that has the keyboard input focus, or `nullptr` if no widget in this application has the focus.

QWidget * topLevelAt(const QPoint &point.brief: Returns the top-level widget at the given *point*; returns `nullptr` if there is no such widget.

QWidget * topLevelAt(int x, int y).brief: Returns the top-level widget at the point (*x*, *y*); returns 0 if there is no such widget.

QWidget * widgetAt(const QPoint &point).brief: Returns the widget at global screen position *point*, or `nullptr` if there is no Qt widget there.

QWidget * widgetAt(int x, int y).brief: Returns the widget at global screen position (*x*, *y*), or `nullptr` if there is no Qt widget there.

QWidgetList allWidgets().brief: Returns a list of all the widgets in the application.

QWidgetList topLevelWidgets().brief: Returns a list of the top-level widgets (windows) in the application.

Qt::NavigationMode navigationMode().brief: Returns what kind of focus navigation Qt is using.

bool autoSipEnabled() const.brief: toggles automatic SIP (software input panel) visibility

bool isEffectEnabled(Qt::UIEffect effect.brief: Returns `true` if *effect* is enabled; otherwise returns `false`.

int cursorFlashTime().brief: This property holds the text cursor's flash (blink) time in milliseconds

int doubleClickInterval().brief: This property holds the time limit in milliseconds that distinguishes a double click from two consecutive mouse clicks

int exec().brief: Enters the main event loop and waits until [exit](xref:qt:QCoreApplication)() is called, then returns the value that was set to [exit](xref:qt:QCoreApplication)() (which is 0 if...

int keyboardInputInterval().brief: This property holds the time limit in milliseconds that distinguishes a key press from two consecutive key presses

int startDragDistance().brief: This property holds the minimum distance required for a drag and drop operation to start.

int startDragTime().brief: This property holds the time in milliseconds that a mouse button must be held down before a drag and drop operation will begin

int wheelScrollLines().brief: This property holds the number of lines to scroll a widget, when the mouse wheel is rotated.

void aboutQt().brief: Displays a simple message box about Qt.

void alert(QWidget *widget, int msec).brief: Causes an alert to be shown for *widget* if the window is not the active window.

void beep().brief: Sounds the bell, using the default volume and sound.

void focusChanged(QWidget *old, QWidget.brief: This signal is emitted when the widget that has keyboard focus changed from *old* to *now*, i.e., because the user pressed the tab-key, clicked into a widget or changed the active window.

void setAutoSipEnabled(const bool enable.brief: toggles automatic SIP (software input panel) visibility

void setCursorFlashTime(int).brief: This property holds the text cursor's flash (blink) time in milliseconds

void setDoubleClickInterval(int).brief: This property holds the time limit in milliseconds that distinguishes a double click from two consecutive mouse clicks

void setEffectEnabled(Qt::UIEffect effec.brief: Enables the UI effect *effect* if *enable* is true, otherwise the effect will not be used.

void setFont(const QFont &font, const ch.brief: Changes the default application font to *font*.

void setKeyboardInputInterval(int).brief: This property holds the time limit in milliseconds that distinguishes a key press from two consecutive key presses

void setNavigationMode(Qt::NavigationMod.brief: Sets the kind of focus navigation Qt should use to *mode*.

void setStartDragDistance(int l).brief: This property holds the minimum distance required for a drag and drop operation to start.

void setStartDragTime(int ms).brief: This property holds the time in milliseconds that a mouse button must be held down before a drag and drop operation will begin

void setStyle(QStyle *style).brief: Sets the application's GUI style to *style*.

void setStyleSheet(const QString &sheet).brief: This property holds the application style sheet

void setWheelScrollLines(int).brief: This property holds the number of lines to scroll a widget, when the mouse wheel is rotated.
